1.consolidated_definition: Adjetivo derivado del participio 'saldado', que se refiere a algo o alguien que ha sido pagado o resuelto.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Adjective derived from the participle 'saldado', referring to something or someone that has been paid or resolved.
